description: Catch after-hours leads for trade and service businesses: when a call, text, or web inquiry arrives after hours or mid-job, the catcher captures it, triages its urgency, drafts a first response for a person to approve and send, and prepares an owner notification. Drafts only — nothing is ever sent automatically, and no discounts or remedies are ever promised. A 5-person trade shop missing ~3 inquiries a week at ~$800 average job value could recover an estimated ~$4,800/mo by responding to half of them — ESTIMATE based on trade benchmarks, not a guarantee.
name: kairos-lead-catcher
